name: @usdk/loader
description: Manifest validation, full transitive dependency-closure resolution (Kahn's algorithm, mirroring src/ffi/manifest.c - never a shortest-path substitute, see docs/ABI.md), and the browser-local dynamic-import loading mechanism.
